newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Act support for NZ govt on hold pending details.
newsitem.headline: Act support for NZ govt on hold pending details.

text.p: Free-market Act New Zealand Party leader Richard Prebble on Wednesday said his party would withhold support for the National-New Zealand First government until all the details of the coalition deal were made public.
"The Act caucus has concluded that it is just not possible to give an indication of support to an agreement which is secret," Prebble said in a letter to Prime Minister Jim Bolger.
